name: Nordkraft Solar Charger Studio
description: The Nordkraft Solar Charger Studio. A dependable power pick with a clean, no-nonsense design and the everyday features you actually use.

specs.inTheBox: Solar Charger, Travel pouch, Quick-start guide, USB-C to USB-C cable

reviews.author: Rohan H.
reviews.title: No complaints at all
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Second Nordkraft product I own and both have lasted. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Gaurav N.
reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.body: Been using this daily for about three months now. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Packaging was tidy and nothing was missing. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Tanvi D.
reviews.title: Expected better
reviews.body: Ordered twice, same problem both times. The fit and finish do not match the photos. First Nordkraft product that has let me down. Cannot recommend it as-is.

reviews.author: Yusuf B.
reviews.title: Solid, boring, reliable
reviews.body: Been using this daily for about three months now. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Nordkraft seem to have got this one right. Happy to recommend it.

reviews.author: Rhea R.
reviews.title: Worth every rupee
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Matches the listing description exactly. No regrets.
